data.one_liner: A Dart library to parse Tiled TMX and JSON map files into useful representations.
data.what_it_does: Parses Tiled map files (TMX and JSON) into Dart objects. It supports external tilesets, object templates, and tile access APIs, and is fully compatible with the Flame game engine.
use_when: You are building a 2D game in Flutter or Dart using Tiled maps.
You need to parse TMX or JSON map files generated by the Tiled map editor.
You are using the Flame game engine and need map loading capabilities.
avoid_when: You are not using Tiled maps for your application or game.
strengths: Supports both TMX and JSON formats.
Handles external files, tilesets, and object templates via custom providers.
Compatible with the Flame game engine.
weaknesses: Limited to parsing Tiled data representations rather than providing high-level rendering out-of-the-box (rendering is typically handled by flame_tiled).
data.minimal_example:
final String tmxBody = /* ... */;
final TiledMap mapTmx = TiledMap.parseTmx(tmxBody);
